code.purpose: Inline code, formulas, MIDI specs only.

motion.name: room-dimmer
motion.purpose: Background/text shift when difficulty changes the room.

components.name: Crayon Key
components.css: .ds-key { font-family: 'Patrick Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.2rem; padding: 14px 24px; background: #4ecdc4; color: #2b2b2b; border: 4px solid #333; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #333; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-key:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px dashed #333; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-key:active { transform: translate(2px,2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #2b8c85; }

components.name: Play Key
components.css: .ds-key-play { font-family: 'Patrick Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.2rem; padding: 14px 24px; background: #96ceb4; color: #2b2b2b; border: 4px solid #333; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #333; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-key-play:focus-visible { outline: 3px dashed #333; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-key-play:active { transform: translate(2px,2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #5b9b78; }

components.name: Nudge / CUE Key
components.description: Secondary hardware actions: CUE, Slower, Faster, Menu.
components.css: .ds-key-nudge { font-family: 'Patrick Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.2rem; padding: 14px 24px; background: #ffeead; color: #2b2b2b; border: 4px solid #333; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #333; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-key-nudge:focus-visible { outline: 3px dashed #333; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-key-nudge:active { transform: translate(2px,2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #d99a38; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Validation status; turns green when OK.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Patrick Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 6px 12px; background: #fff; color: #2b2b2b; border: 2px solid #333; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #333; } .ds-chip-ok { background: #1e8449; color: #fff; }

components.name: Level Tile
components.description: Home navigation tile: unlocked vs locked slot.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; font-family: 'Patrick Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-weight: 700; color: #2b2b2b; text-decoration: none; background: #fff; border: 3px solid #333; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #333; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px dashed #333; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tile-locked { background: transparent; color: #bbb; border: 2px dashed #ddd; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Coach Speech Bubble
components.html: Yoo nouvelle recrue, on commence la base !
components.css: .ds-bubble { position: relative; max-width: 260px; font-family: 'Patrick Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.4; padding: 16px 20px; background: #fff; color: #2b2b2b; border: 3px solid #333; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-bubble::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 40px; top: -12px; border: 10px solid transparent; border-bottom-color: #333; border-top: 0; }

components.name: Glyph
components.description: House felt-pen pictograms replacing emoji (phrases, wagons, feedback).
components.css: .ds-glyphs { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-glyphs svg { filter: drop-shadow(2px 2px 0 #333); }

narrative.overview:
A real DJ booth redrawn in felt pen. Every control the learner touches (pitch fader, nudge, EQ pots, crossfader, CUE / Play) exists on real hardware, and the interface keeps that function intact while drawing it like a toy console: thick ink outlines, chunky rounded shapes, flat crayon fills, and a hard offset shadow that makes each control look like a plastic part you could slap. The cartoon Patrick illustrations (src/assets/*_patrick.png) set the line quality; the UI is drawn in the same hand.

The world changes with the hour of the set. Night falls on the club as difficulty rises: EASY is daytime practice on cream paper, MEDIUM is dusk in warm taupe, PRO is night in deep slate. The ink, crayon fills and workshop colors stay constant; only the room around them dims. The Secret Booth is the one place already inside the club at full dark, with a warm orange glow.

Density is game-like rather than app-like: few controls per screen, each large enough to hit with a thumb, with the gameplay area (trains, track lanes, mixer) given most of the viewport.
keyCharacteristics: One handwritten face (Patrick Hand) everywhere, set heavy for anything you press.
Ink-gray outlines (#333) of 2–4px on every interactive part.
Hard, unblurred offset shadows instead of soft elevation.
One color per workshop, used as its thread from home to practice.
Ambient theme switches by difficulty via data-theme on the root; components only read tokens.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Crayon Rule
rules.body: Text on a crayon, coral, sky or bright-green fill is ink (#2b2b2b), never white. White text only sits on the status fills or on ink.

rules.name: The Hour-of-the-Set Rule
rules.body: Difficulty never changes components, only the room. Anything that sits on the background must read from --surface, --surface-elevated, --text, --text-muted, --border, --border-strong, --accent-env (src/theme.css), never a hard-coded room color, so it survives the switch to dusk and night.

rules.name: The Constant Crayon Rule
rules.body: The crayon fills, the ink, and the workshop colors are Patrick's identity and do not shift with the theme.

rules.name: The One Hand Rule
rules.body: Patrick Hand everywhere. Monospace exists only for code, formulas and MIDI data; it is never a display or body voice.

rules.name: The Drawn Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is an offset, not a blur. If it needs a blur radius, it doesn't belong outside the Secret Booth.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing functional below 0.7rem (11.2px), including chips, BPM mode toggles and knob labels.

rules.name: The No-Emoji Rule
rules.body: Every pictogram is drawn in the house felt-pen style (Glyph: 24-grid, ink stroke 2, crayon fill, no blur). Emoji never ship in the UI.

rules.name: The White-Card Ink Rule
rules.body: Any panel that is always white or cream (end cards, crowd meter, deck cards, bubbles, phrase pills) sets its own ink text color (#2b2b2b). Never let it inherit the room text color, which is light at dusk and night.

rules.name: The Workshop-Ink Rule
rules.body: When a workshop color must read as text (lesson bold terms, titles), use --lesson-ink = 20% workshop color mixed into the theme text color; bright workshop colors stay for lines, dots and fills.

dos: Do outline every pressable thing in ink (#333) and give it a hard offset shadow.
Do read room colors from the theme variables so EASY / MEDIUM / PRO all work.
Do keep a workshop's own color as its thread (rule line, icons, accents).
Do keep touch targets chunky; the same screen must play on a phone.
Do match the line and palette of the existing Patrick illustrations for any new visual.
Do ship illustrations as WebP at about 2× their displayed size (originals live in src/assets/_originals_backup/).
Do let MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" handle framer motion; never remove the trains' scrolling, it is the game information.
Do verify every UI change at 360, 390, 667×375, 844×390, 768, 1024, 1280×720, 1440 and 1920 wide, in Chrome and Firefox, with zero overlaps.
Do tell Train A (coral locomotive) and Train B (blue locomotive) apart by color, not only by lane.
donts: Don't position anything over the playfield (position: fixed/absolute coach, chips or pills); put it in the level bar or the coach strip.

Don't use emoji or Unicode pictographs as icons. Draw it in Glyph (or a dedicated icon component) in the felt-pen style. Musical and typographic signs (♭ ♯ ↔ → ← ✓ inside sentences) are text, not icons, and stay.
Don't use blurred drop shadows, glassmorphism or gradients on game UI (the Secret Booth's night-club look is the only exception).
Don't add a second typeface for headings or body.
Don't hard-code cream or white backgrounds on components that sit on the room: they break at dusk and night.
Don't change crayon or workshop colors per difficulty.
Don't redraw or restyle Patrick himself; the illustration set is canon.
